Bash(git commit -m "$\(cat <<''EOF''
fix\(PROJ-2\): Use Service Role client for DELETE to bypass audit_log RLS

BUG-5: audit_log RLS policy blocks DELETE operations because
audit_trigger_function\(\) runs as postgres role which cannot insert
into audit_log table.

Fix:
- Changed DELETE endpoint to use supabaseAdmin \(service_role\)
- Added manual ownership check since RLS is bypassed
- Preserves security model while allowing audit_log writes

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
\)")
